verdict.rationale: Productboard documents a product hierarchy that includes features, subfeatures, components and initiatives. Feedback can be linked to features, components and other hierarchy entities, and features can be added to initiatives. Most of this evidence comes from API and MCP docs rather than a description of in-app organizing. Missing for 10: first-party UI documentation of building and managing the feature/component/initiative hierarchy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can organize requests into a hierarchy of features, components, and initiatives

citations.quote: Associate feedback with users and companies, and connect it to features, components, and other product hierarchy entities.
Create and update features, subfeatures, initiatives, releases, objectives, key results, companies, users, feedback, documents, and more directly from your agent
Add features to initiatives, move an initiative to a new release, or create key results beneath an objective.
Notes can be linked to features to quantify demand and inform prioritization.
